desc: Ideation complete: Determine the correct O(N) algorithm using contribution technique with monotonic stacks to handle the k-length constraint.
Compute prev_smaller and next_smaller_or_equal arrays using monotonic stacks.
Compute prev_greater and next_greater_or_equal arrays using monotonic stacks.
Implement helper function to calculate count of subarrays for a given element being min/max with length <= k.
Iterate through the array, calculating contributions for each element as min and max, and accumulate the total sum.
